decision.releaseRule: All capabilities remain present in source and package scope; authority is promoted independently only after its own evidence gate.
decision.rollbackRule: Lower a capability authority mode or use mechanical-only rollback without deleting capability code, widening permissions, or rewriting persisted truth.

authorityVocabulary.rule: Mode controls activation; authority controls what the capability may cause. Observe and advise may not block, mutate, dispatch, or add a model continuation.

layers.name: hard-invariants
layers.rollback: emergency runtime rollback only; never silently disabled by a normal feature flag

layers.name: mechanical-efficiency
layers.rollback: mechanical-only or per-feature off while preserving L0

layers.name: guidance
layers.rollback: shadow or off; no automatic continuation

layers.name: bounded-enforcement
layers.rollback: shadow/off with explicit handoff for incompatible active state

capabilities.name: Task Contract and intake truth
capabilities.purpose: Create and preserve the sole durable statement of task identity, scope, acceptance criteria, attempts, and outcome.
capabilities.trigger: Task intake, explicit task start, resume, and terminal projection.
capabilities.budget: Prompt intake <=8000 characters; automatic criteria <=12 and each fragment <=600 characters; no projection may truncate contract truth.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Ambiguous or incompatible identity fails closed to handoff or a new attempt; never infer completion.
capabilities.killSwitch: L0 emergency rollback only; active task state requires explicit compatibility handling.

capabilities.name: Permission, scope, protected-path, and external-action guards
capabilities.purpose: Keep model/tool actions inside operator authority, project scope, and protected/external-action policy.
capabilities.trigger: Every tool authorization, shell analysis, MCP action, and protected or external target.
capabilities.budget: Synchronous deterministic authorization; no provider retry may widen scope or approval.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Deny before mutation and return a classified, redacted reason; uncertain targets fail closed.
capabilities.killSwitch: L0 emergency rollback only; external and destructive confirmation remains mandatory.

capabilities.name: Current-tree, verifier, and terminal truth
capabilities.purpose: Bind proof to the exact current tree and latest stable execution of every configured verifier before terminal completion.
capabilities.trigger: Verifier call/result, tree mutation, completion request, and terminal write.
capabilities.budget: One stable pre/post snapshot per exact verifier execution; current digest namespace is wt-content-v2.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Missing, unavailable, stale, tree-changing, or mixed-digest proof cannot complete or score as current.
capabilities.killSwitch: L0 emergency rollback only; historical evidence remains immutable and untrusted for current proof.

capabilities.name: Journal, checkpoint, resume, and handoff
capabilities.purpose: Make long work resumable without accepting stale, corrupt, cross-session, or partial state.
capabilities.trigger: Durable event append, checkpoint, interruption, process restart, resume, and handoff.
capabilities.budget: Journal <=5000 events and <=64 KiB per event; handoff <=1 MiB; one immutable terminal outcome.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Corruption, identity conflict, unsafe active state, or stale evidence blocks mutation and requires handoff/new attempt.
capabilities.killSwitch: L0 emergency rollback only; preserve evidence and never auto-delete incompatible state.

capabilities.name: Context budgets and compaction
capabilities.purpose: Bound model context and tool-output growth while retaining task-critical evidence.
capabilities.trigger: Input classification, context-pack assembly, tool-result capture, and context thresholds.
capabilities.budget: Watch 50%, compact 70%, fresh 82%; tool result 12000 chars/180 lines with 6000-char preview; capture <=500 KiB; source file <=512 KiB and repository index <=8000 files.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Compaction failure degrades to bounded evidence and explicit unknown; never drop L0 proof silently.
capabilities.killSwitch: mechanical-only retains this capability; individual automatic context selection may be disabled.

capabilities.name: Tool groups and schema-stable runtime
capabilities.purpose: Expose a small stable provider tool surface while enforcing runtime permission at call time.
capabilities.trigger: Session start, runtime registration, tool call, tool result, and mode resolution.
capabilities.budget: Provider-visible schema must remain stable across phase transitions; registration and hook paths stay within architecture line budgets.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Unavailable or unauthorized runtime action fails closed without changing schemas mid-session.
capabilities.killSwitch: mechanical-only retains the stable base group; optional groups can be disabled without weakening L0.

capabilities.name: Repository memory and retrieval
capabilities.purpose: Recommend bounded, current, cited repository context without automatic model-work expansion.
capabilities.trigger: Repository search/memory request or context recommendation.
capabilities.budget: Bounded citations and current-file validation; no automatic helper or provider dispatch at RC default.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Stale, missing, or unverifiable citations are omitted; base task continues without them.
capabilities.killSwitch: off or shadow; repository memory bytes remain preserved.

capabilities.name: Solver, model, and effort decision
capabilities.purpose: Observe and explain routing/effort opportunities without replacing the operator-selected model in the first release candidate.
capabilities.trigger: Task feature extraction and model catalog inspection.
capabilities.budget: Local deterministic decision only; zero model turns and zero automatic model substitution.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Missing catalog or low confidence records abstention and preserves the selected model/effort.
capabilities.killSwitch: off; no task truth or operator selection is rewritten.

capabilities.name: Phase classifier and phase tools
capabilities.purpose: Observe task-phase/tool mismatches before any production enforcement promotion.
capabilities.trigger: Tool call classification and task phase transition.
capabilities.budget: Zero extra model turns; provider tool schema stays unchanged.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Classifier uncertainty cannot block a valid call in the release default.
capabilities.killSwitch: off; strict phase enforcement remains an independent opt-in promotion.

capabilities.name: Trajectory and long-task observability
capabilities.purpose: Record bounded phase progress and durable long-task transitions without steering by itself.
capabilities.trigger: Phase transition, verification, recovery, checkpoint, resume, and terminal event.
capabilities.budget: Bounded append-only event/state projection within journal limits; no provider turn.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Invalid or conflicting trajectory blocks unsafe resume through L0 but does not invent progress.
capabilities.killSwitch: observation can be hidden from guidance, but persisted safety evidence is retained.

capabilities.name: Acceptance and performance assurance
capabilities.purpose: Project criterion and performance risks as bounded advice while Task Contract and exact verifiers remain authoritative.
capabilities.trigger: Current-tree receipt refresh and completion projection.
capabilities.budget: Zero automatic model continuations in the broad RC profile; finite local analysis; projection must cover all contract criteria without truncation.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Unsupported syntax, ambiguous causality, or incomplete evidence yields unknown/advice rather than a hard block in the broad profile.
capabilities.killSwitch: off or shadow; Task Contract, verifier evidence, and prior receipts remain intact.

capabilities.name: Recovery
capabilities.purpose: Perform one bounded, evidence-classified continuation when it is safer and cheaper than handoff.
capabilities.trigger: Failed verifier, transient infrastructure result, or explicit recoverable completion state.
capabilities.budget: Target global maximum one system-triggered continuation per task across all recovery classes.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Repeated hypothesis, unknown progress, unsafe mutation, or exhausted budget immediately hands off.
capabilities.killSwitch: off returns to ordinary fail-closed handoff and preserves recovery history.

capabilities.name: Semantic review and repair
capabilities.purpose: Offer narrowly authorized semantic repair for high-risk opt-in tasks after exact evidence identifies a bounded conflict.
capabilities.trigger: Strict-profile completion with current-digest critical conflict and explicit eligible paths.
capabilities.budget: Strict profile only; <=12 paths, <=2 revisions, <=8 successful mutations, <=3 unsuccessful calls, and subject to the global continuation budget.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Missing/corrupt state, target drift, unavailable proof, carrier escape, or ceiling exhaustion fails closed to handoff.
capabilities.killSwitch: off/shadow for new tasks; incompatible active strict state requires explicit handoff or pinned-policy resume.

capabilities.name: Helpers, subagents, and Oracle
capabilities.purpose: Recommend bounded specialist help while preserving one-writer ownership and operator/model control.
capabilities.trigger: Independent review, repository scouting, planning, or high-risk uncertainty signal.
capabilities.budget: No automatic dispatch at RC default; owned-work ceiling 2 concurrent/3 total, one per read-only role and one writer.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Unavailable, duplicate, expired, or conflicting helper work returns to the parent; late results are ignored.
capabilities.killSwitch: off; helper state is cancelled/expired without altering parent task truth.

capabilities.name: Parent auto-routing and workers
capabilities.purpose: Retain future parent-routing and worker surfaces without granting production orchestration authority before field evidence.
capabilities.budget: Zero automatic parent routing and zero automatic worker dispatch in the first release candidate.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Always preserve the operator-selected parent and return a recommendation or abstention.
capabilities.killSwitch: already off by default; experimental state can be discarded without deleting source.

capabilities.name: Operator UX, packaging, install, update, and rollback
capabilities.purpose: Provide truthful operator views and a reproducible package/install/update/rollback boundary.
capabilities.trigger: CLI, setup, doctor, status, packaging, install, update, rollback, and profile resolution.
capabilities.budget: No external install/publish/tag/push without explicit operator approval; package contains only declared release assets.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Identity mismatch, missing artifact, dirty candidate, unsupported platform, or credential risk blocks release action.
capabilities.killSwitch: operator-selected rollback to exact prior artifact; never erase user auth, sessions, memory, or task evidence.

capabilities.name: Benchmark, telemetry, and claim tiers
capabilities.purpose: Measure exact candidate behavior and separate diagnostic, causal, release, and generalization claims.
capabilities.trigger: Local evaluation, controlled canary, causal pilot, release benchmark, or cohort evidence ingest.
capabilities.budget: Provider runs require separate approval and finite stop rules; release benchmark is Piagent versus Codex CLI on the exact candidate and identical Luna Medium policy.
capabilities.failurePolicy: Unaccepted, contaminated, partial, unstable, underpowered, or incomparable evidence cannot support token/release claims.
capabilities.killSwitch: stop provider execution; preserve immutable evidence and produce a no-claim report.

exclusions.reason: validation code, not a shipped production module
documentation is governed in CF-FS0-04 and release gates, not runtime ownership
ignored raw historical/private evidence, never release input

productionModuleScope.resolution: Apply orderedOwnershipRules by first match; fallback CAP-16 owns packaging/operator static assets. Each in-scope regular file resolves to exactly one primary capability.

orderedOwnershipRules.match: benchmarks/**, evals/**, core benchmark/**, evaluation scripts, benchmark/eval schemas
remaining runtime/recovery, failure types and failure schemas
runtime/solver, remaining runtime/model, model/solver/task-feature schemas and model scripts
repository-memory, retrieval-route-policy, source-cache skill, knowledge/memory registration
context engine/index, document intake, adaptive planner, tool-result compaction, context schema/script
task state/lifecycle/view, project shape, intake/routing, task start/preflight, Task Contract schema
remaining runtime hooks/session/tools/registration and runtime limits
fallback: profiles, templates, package metadata, capability inventory, operator/product UI, prompts and release scripts

coverageProof.algorithm: Sort all in-scope regular paths; assign the first matching rule; hash JSON(path list) and JSON([{path,cap,size,mode,sha256}]).

testOnlyBarrel.releaseDisposition: exclude unless a production import is introduced and integrity-bound

knownDeviations.finding: Continuation authority is split: completion recovery allows 2 attempts, performance review allows 3 attempts, and recovery classes have separate ceilings.
knownDeviations.target: One system-triggered continuation total per task in the broad production profile.

knownDeviations.finding: Automatic intake may preserve 12 acceptance criteria while acceptance receipt projection caps processing at 8.
knownDeviations.target: Task Contract remains sole truth and every criterion is projected without silent truncation; unsupported evidence abstains.

knownDeviations.finding: Eight runtime-referenced modules are not explicitly bound by runtime-integrity inventory.
knownDeviations.target: Bind every shipped runtime dependency on the exact candidate.

knownDeviations.finding: core-services.js is a test-only aggregation barrel inside package source.
knownDeviations.target: Exclude it from release package or production-import and integrity-bind it; do not delete source during constitution work.

knownDeviations.finding: Historical capability canaries exercised stricter phase/review behavior than the target broad release defaults.
knownDeviations.target: Benchmark treatment must snapshot and match the exact release policy manifest.

promotionOrder: L0 invariants and L1 mechanical efficiency
CAP-15 parent routing and automatic workers only after beta field evidence
